value.rationale: The result gives a natural complete equality classification at the first nontrivial ternary exact case already singled out in the SHF literature. It shows the standard witness is forced up to equivalence, identifies the common-singleton/parity mechanism, and gives exact labeled and stabilizer counts. This is structural information not supplied by recomputing the known optimum size alone.
